summary_en: 605,292 ordinary shares to be cancelled (3.37% of issued shares including treasury). Cancellation scheduled for 2026-10-13. Conditional on shareholder approval of a stock split (effective 2026-10-14) at the extraordinary general meeting planned for 2026-09-10. Post-cancellation issued share count: 17,371,308 shares.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Anshin Guarantor Service resolved by board decision on 2026-08-05 to cancel treasury shares under Company Law Article 178. The cancellation covers 605,292 ordinary shares, representing 3.37% of total issued shares (including treasury holdings). The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 2026-10-13. Execution is conditional on shareholder approval of a concurrent stock split (effective 2026-10-14) to be voted at an extraordinary general meeting planned for 2026-09-10. Post-cancellation, the company will have 17,371,308 issued shares outstanding. The 605,292 shares to be cancelled represent all treasury shares held as of 2026-07-18.
